title: microrphium pubescens subsp. elmerianum
intro: Microrphium pubescens subsp. elmerianum, commonly known as Elmer's Microrphium, is a plant species in the genus Microrphium. It is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. Elmer's Microrphium has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and anticancer properties.
